summary.en: On paper the anchor rises into its point and lands on beat 1; a contact wave and coarse rings run out of it; the problem lands in one or two big lines.
summary.zh: 纸面上锚点升到它的位置并在第 1 拍落定；接触波和粗网点圆环从它向外扩散；问题用一两行大字落下。

fits: The hook of a print film: the problem stated beside the one brand piece that will run through the film.
notFor: Openings without a mark piece; long setups.

intent.en: The one brand piece arrives first and the problem lands beside it, so the viewer has a focal point before any feature.
intent.zh: 唯一的品牌件先到，问题落在它旁边，观众在任何功能之前就有了视觉焦点。

content.en: One or two problem lines (≤ 15 chars / 8 字 each), an optional label (≤ 30 / 16 字).
content.zh: 一到两行问题（每行 ≤ 15 字符 / 8 字），可选标签（≤ 30 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 印刷风格片的钩子：问题陈述在那个贯穿全片的品牌件旁边。

notFor.zh: 没有标志件的开场；长铺垫。

en: Keep the opening field coarse and light (24 px screen, peak 0.36); a dense first screen buries the anchor.
zh: 开场的场要粗而淡（24 px 网，峰值 0.36）；第一屏太密会埋掉锚点。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
